<fig> and <stamp> tags only; scenery is painted by another hand. I need jam jars drawn myself, a flour sack, and sunbeams.

Plan: Bao climbs on the left, with the jar stack as a drawn thing written before her. Bolt is on the right, reaching up with the spoon. The flour sack goes behind, drawn first, on the right at the back.

Jars: three stacked at left, x 130-190. Jar 1 at the bottom (y 245, top 215), jar 2 (top 185), jar 3 (top 155). Bao stands on jar 2 or 3, reaching to a lid above. A fourth jar sits higher on the left, with its lid at about y 120. Bao at s 0.8 has her feet on jar 3 at y 185, and her hand reaches up to the lid of jar 4 at about y 120. Her head top is at 185-136 = 49, which is slightly high, so I'll put her feet at y 195 on a jar top at 195. Jars: bottom y 245 to 215 (width 50), second 215 to 195? I'll make jars 30 tall: j1 215-245, j2 195-225, offset. Simpler: Bao's feet at y 190 on j2 (top 190), with j1 under it from 190 to 245 (a tall jar). A higher jar j3 sits at the left behind her with its lid at y 140.

Bolt: s 1.0 at x 255, y 245, arms reach up, holding the spoon at about x 280, y 170. Bolt faces left, flipped. His hands are at x - 30, y - 75, so the spoon goes there, aimed at Bao at x 170. Bolt at x 250: hands at 220, 170. The spoon is drawn as a gold line from (222,175) up to (205,130), with a bowl at the top. Bao at x 160 reaches down.
